For bounded initial D and fixed threshold R, eventual negative q velocity and exponentially bounded tanh deficiency yield T_R=|q0|/a+O(1). The focus/node discriminant is eps(eps-4a); cubic nonlinearity preserves asymptotic crossing classification. value.rationale: A directed, asymmetric learning rule can create complex dynamics in other parameter regions; identifying a physically natural quadrature interaction boundary where all initial couplings lead to a phase-controlled deterministic outcome has structural relevance. The exact lifetime coupling asymmetry and sharp divergence of transient capture near invariant phase barriers quantify adaptation costs and slow synchronization beyond equilibrium stability. The focus-to-node threshold provides an explicit change of response regime. This is not asserted for arbitrary parameter slices or larger networks.
